name: lidnight
displayName: Lidnight — keep your Mac awake while Claude works
description: Slash commands for Claude Code on macOS: a session receipt (runtime, agents, leftover processes, token totals) and a usage-limits summary that work on their own, plus keep-awake commands that drive the Lidnight menu bar app (free with the lid open; lid closed is Pro, on battery or plugged in), with plain caffeinate/pmset fallbacks.
